exit: 2
--- stdout
--- stderr
Author, check and inspect Open Control Engine sequences

Usage: oce [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  emit      Validate a sequence, then write it as flat CXF
  validate  Validate a sequence and print the findings as a JSON report
  fmt       Print the canonical text form of a sequence
  catalog   List the block classes, or describe one: its ports, parameters, units, ranges and notes
  vocab     Print the text-form vocabulary, the unit scale factors and every code oce reports
  verify    Replay a vector set against a subject, or a commissioning spec against its trends, and print the receipt
  id        Print the canonical content id of a CXF document or an authored sequence
  import    Read a flat CXF document into the authoring form
  diff      Compare two sequences, or two CXF documents, and print the structural diff
  help      Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --render <RENDER>  When to write a human-readable rendering of the report to stderr [default: auto] [possible values: auto, always, never]
  -h, --help             Print help (see more with '--help')
  -V, --version          Print version
